messages:
maria_cs: quick pulse — we're launching a high-touch 'Adoption Sprint' for a few renewal-risk accounts next month. Need to lock instructor rotations and a single recurring 90-min office hour. who's available for week-of Apr 20? :wave:
jonathan_se: I can do Mon/Wed mornings PDT (8:30-10am). prefer demos + live QA.
lee_enable: I'll cover Tue/Thu 11-1 PDT. can share slides and the migration checklist.
ana_product: Heads up: product wants a 15m roadmap update in the middle. can we reserve 10:45-11:00 on the session?
maria_cs: good call. planning one kickoff + three 90-min workshops across 2 weeks. proposed cadence: Kickoff Mon Apr 21 09:00 PT; Workshops Tue/Wed/Thu 09:00 PT. Anyone opposed?
jonathan_se: nope works for me. can rotate instructors; I'll take workshop 1.
lee_enable: I'll take workshop 2. volunteer for backup on 3.
sorin_ops_bot: calendar event created: https://cal.example.com/event/abc123 — invites sent to participants. :calendar:
maria_cs: thanks all. @ana_product will you drop the 15m slide deck here by EOD Fri? also please add any customer-specific asks.
ana_product: on it. uploading in #cs-assets by 5pm.
lee_enable: :thumbsup: also tagging @oncall_eng in case we need dedicated capacity bump for live demos.
jonathan_se: noted — I'll prep a short list of demos + dataset to avoid noisy downstream requests.
maria_cs: final ask: please fill this quick availability form so we can pick backups: https://forms.example.com/enable-rotations (2-min).
